integrity: Complete stand-alone proof, two standard-library checkers and captured outputs. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only linear powers of a permutation on at least three distinct letters; n>=2; deleted patterns have length exactly one above the period. The already known embedding count and threshold are excluded from the novelty claim. A plausible unindexed equivalent and incomplete full-text access to arXiv:2601.06493 remain priority risks. Finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.
title: Complete first-postperiod complement-deletion spectra of permutation powers
